BootstrapDocInput.title: BootstrapDocInput
BootstrapDocInput.description:
POST body for /api/v1/kb/bootstrap-docs.

Only ``platform`` is required.  Every other field falls back to the
matching ``DocumentConfig`` in ``agent.yml`` (``agent.document.<platform>``).

components.title: Components
components.description: Knowledge base components to initialize. `metadata` scans live database schema and sample rows; `semantic_model` derives semantic schema objects from success-story SQLs; `metrics` derives MetricFlow-style business metrics; `ext_knowledge` imports or generates business terminology/knowledge entries; `reference_sql` indexes reusable SQL files.

strategy.title: Strategy
strategy.description: Update strategy. `check` inspects existing data without rebuilding where supported, `overwrite` clears and rebuilds, and `incremental` appends or updates changed entries.

schema_linking_type.title: Schema Linking Type
schema_linking_type.description: Metadata-only option controlling which object types are indexed from the database. Expected values follow `dataengineer-agent bootstrap-kb`: `table`, `view`, `mv`, or `full`.

catalog.title: Catalog
catalog.description: Optional metadata catalog filter. Mainly relevant for engines with a catalog layer, such as Snowflake or StarRocks.

database_name.title: Database Name
database_name.description: Optional metadata database filter. Passed through to adapter-specific initialization; for Snowflake it maps to schema name, while for MySQL/PostgreSQL/StarRocks it is the database name.

success_story.title: Success Story
success_story.description: Project-root-relative path to a success-story CSV containing historical question/SQL pairs. Used by `semantic_model`, `metrics`, and `ext_knowledge` when bootstrapping from success stories.

subject_tree.title: Subject Tree
subject_tree.description: Optional predefined hierarchical categories in `domain/layer1/layer2` form, such as `Sales/Reporting/Daily`. Used by `metrics`, `ext_knowledge`, and `reference_sql`; if omitted, bootstrap reuses or learns categories from existing KB content.

sql_dir.title: Sql Dir
sql_dir.description: Project-root-relative directory containing `.sql` files for the `reference_sql` component. Files are scanned recursively and only `SELECT` statements are indexed.

ext_knowledge.title: Ext Knowledge
ext_knowledge.description: Project-root-relative CSV for the `ext_knowledge` component. Expected columns are `subject_path`, `name`, `search_text`, and `explanation`. If omitted, external knowledge can be generated from `success_story` instead.
